name: Red Bridge Brewing Co
address: South Africa, 5 Noble St, Knysna Industrial, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Knysna's craft brewery serving freshly brewed beers, wood-fired pizzas, and relaxed beer garden vibes in the industrial area.
description_long:
Tucked away in Knysna's industrial area, Red Bridge Brewing Co is where local craft beer meets laid-back good times. This working brewery serves up a rotating selection of freshly brewed lagers, ales, and seasonal specials, all crafted on-site and best enjoyed in their spacious beer garden. The wood-fired pizzas are a crowd favourite, with generous toppings and perfectly charred crusts that pair beautifully with a cold draught.

The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, with rustic wooden tables, industrial touches, and a family-friendly vibe that makes it easy to settle in for the afternoon. Whether you're a craft beer enthusiast keen to sample their latest brew or just looking for a relaxed spot with good food and company, Red Bridge delivers without pretension. It's also a popular stop for tourists wanting to take home a few bottles from their on-site liquor store.
